pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown, irregularly polygonal regions with highly jagged, serrated edges. Individual patches exhibit high angularity with sharp pixel-level transitions into the light interstitial pathways. Patch area decreases significantly in the distal direction towards the lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored pathways forming a non-rectilinear grid. Junction nodes primarily exhibit three-way and four-way intersections. Pathway thickness is variable, narrowing in the dorsal region and widening towards the ventral flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder. The mane presents as a thin, dark line of short hair protruding from the dorsal contour.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct structural break in the continuous mane line is visible at the junction of the mid-neck and the shoulder transition.
